jobs.description: Growing at HP — a Two-Way PropositionAt HP, you’ll have opportunities to learn, grow, develop, and shape your career while helping build a better world. From global learning platforms, courses and certifications to career mobility, leadership development and continuous feedback, HP provides an environment designed to support your growth.Growth is a two-way proposition. We’re looking for someone who brings ambition, curiosity, and entrepreneurial spirit and is ready to:- Step up and take responsibility rather than wait for direction- Take on challenges and stretch beyond the comfort zone- Use sound judgment, including when decisions need to be made with incomplete information- Challenge the status quo constructively and find simpler, faster, or more effective ways of working- Proactively remove obstacles rather than wait for direction- Learn continuously from both successes and setbacksIf you are commercially minded and energized by the opportunity to own a meaningful part of HP’s Consumer business across DACH, this role offers the opportunity to make a visible impact and shape your next career step at HP.The RoleAs Consumer Area Category Country Manager (m-f-d), you will own end-to-end product-line management and drive the growth and profitability of a defined part of HP’s Consumer Personal Systems (CPS) portfolio across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.You will have product-line P&L and quota accountability for Consumer HW & Services and take ownership of revenue, unit volume, and Owned Gross Margin.This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-manager role. You will lead through influence without direct authority, bringing together Sales, Channel, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Pricing, Business Management and Alliances.You will develop and execute category business plans and growth strategies, use data and customer insights to identify opportunities, and build strong relationships with the sales force and external partners to champion the category in the market.Key Responsibilities- Strategy & Business Planning: Shape the Consumer category business plan and growth strategy for DACH, identifying market opportunities and developing strategies to drive revenue and profitability. Lead product positioning and pricing strategy and translate long-term vision into short-term action plans.- Product-Line Ownership: Manage the Consumer product portfolio end-to-end with P&L and quota accountability, including revenue, unit volume, and Owned Gross Margin (OGM). Oversee new-product introductions, assortment planning, transitions, and phase-outs to ensure the portfolio meets DACH market needs.- Cross-Functional Leadership: Work across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Channel, Pricing, Business Management and Alliances to ensure seamless execution of category plans. Build consensus, negotiate priorities, and move decisions forward without direct authority.- Performance & Optimization: Monitor KPIs including sales performance, market share, inventory, OGM, sell-in and sell-through. Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities and translate them into clear improvement actions.- Customer & Market Insights: Use customer feedback, market data, and competitive insights to understand consumer needs and identify opportunities to improve products, positioning, and go-to-market strategies across DACH.- Product Marketing: Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and evolving consumer demand, including the shift toward solution-oriented selling and AI-driven mobility devices. Guide pricing, promotions, channel programs, product launches, messaging, and value propositions.- Channel Partner Engagement: Build strong relationships with retail partners, distributors, and the DACH sales force. Provide product knowledge, sales tools, and insights while representing the category in internal sales and external partner meetings.- Supply & Demand Alignment: Work with demand planning and supply-chain teams to ensure product availability while limiting expedited freight or E&O exposure. Manage product transitions in close coordination with Business Management and Pricing.- Entrepreneurial Ownership: Act like an owner of the business. Improve processes, forecasting, and reporting; take calculated risks; challenge established approaches constructively; make decisions with appropriate speed; and proactively remove obstacles to execution.Qualifications and Skills- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales Administration, or a related field. However, education level shouldn’t stop you from applying – there is nothing that can’t be learned.- 2–5 years of professional experience in category management, product/brand management, P&L management, or a related role, ideally with direct involvement in driving business results. Experience in the consumer products or technology/IT industry is highly beneficial.- Strategic & analytical thinking with confidence working with sales figures, market research, KPIs, forecasts, and analytical tools such as Excel.- Commercial acumen and understanding of revenue, unit volume, Owned Gross Margin, market share, inventory, and ROI, with the ability to balance these in day-to-day decisions.- Excellent communication skills in German and English, with the ability to clearly communicate category plans and results across different audiences.- Strong collaboration and influencing skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority, negotiate priorities, and build consensus across functions.- Results-driven and ownership-oriented mindset, with strong project management, prioritization, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment.- Sound judgment and calculated risk-taking, including the ability to make decisions with incomplete information, balance speed against risk, and constructively challenge the status quo.- Learning agility, curiosity, and resilience to thrive in a changing environment, learn quickly, and continuously develop as HP’s Consumer business evolves.What do we have to offer?- Employee-oriented corporate culture - our «HP Way (http://jobs.hp.com/#the-hp-way) »: We value enthusiasm, regular feedback, trust and respect within our teams. We want to promote meaningful innovation within each and every employee by giving them the opportunity to grow from their mistakes and get new inspirations through collaboration in our regional/global teams.- A well-adjusted work-life-balance due to flexible working hours and home office regulations.- Attractive salary package with additional benefits, such as 30 paid leave days, company pension plans, a long-term time account, bike leasing, employee counselling programs, wellness initiatives etc.- Equal opportunities and continuous career development, e.g. as part of the global mentoring programs, e-learning platforms.- Multiple Employee Impact Networks such as Next Generation Network, Women’s Network and Pride Network which organize interesting trainings and after-work events to expand your network.You are convinced to be a perfect match? Then join our HP family and apply now!You want to know more about us? jobs.occupation: Staff Network Reliability Engineer (f/m/d) / 1610 (Site Reliability Engineer)
jobs.description: About IONOSAt IONOS, we don't just manage servers – we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure – from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.Tasks- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.Qualifications- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.Benefits- Hybrid working model.- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.- Modern office space with very good transport connections.- Various employee discounts for activities and products.- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.- Numerous training and development opportunities.- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.
